description: This file defines the `ToyVpnClient` class, an Android Activity responsible for managing the user interface and preferences for a Toy VPN client app. It handles user input, preference storage, and initiates VPN connection/disconnection tasks.

classes.name: ToyVpnClient
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages user preferences and initiates VPN connection/disconnection for a toy VPN application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, loads preferences, and registers click listeners for connect/disconnect actions.

methods.name: checkProxyConfigs
methods.description: Validates if proxy host and port configurations are complete; shows a toast warning if incomplete.

methods.name: checkPackages
methods.description: Validates if the list of package names to allow are installed on the device; shows a toast warning if unknown packages are specified.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the VPN preparation intent and initiates connection if approved.

methods.name: getServiceIntent
methods.description: Builds an intent targeting the `ToyVpnService` for starting/stopping VPN.
